title: RBI KYC Update Scam
text: Fraudsters send messages claiming your bank KYC has expired and ask you to click a link or install an app. Legitimate banks do not ask customers to update KYC through random SMS or WhatsApp links.
summary: Fake KYC verification messages attempt to steal banking credentials.
recommended_actions: Contact the bank using official customer care.

title: UPI Collect Request Scam
text: Fraudsters send UPI collect requests claiming they are sending money. Accepting the request actually debits money from your account.
summary: UPI collect requests can withdraw money instead of sending it.

title: Digital Arrest Scam
text: Scammers impersonate police or government agencies and falsely claim that the victim is under digital arrest. They demand money to avoid legal action.
summary: No law enforcement agency conducts digital arrests over video calls.
